title: fix: publish polli-cli 0.1.40 with sandbox create --timeout
author: voodoohop

gist.summary: Bumped @pollinations/cli from 0.1.39 to 0.1.40 so the npm release workflow can publish the previously added `polli sandbox create --timeout` option. The earlier CLI change had no version bump, leaving npm's 0.1.39 without the flag even though the sandbox docs show `polli sandbox create --timeout 0`.
